courses.title: Administration and Management of,Outdoor Leadership Programs

notes.content: The Outdoor Adventure Recreation major is designed to equip students as leaders who are competent in guiding groups in outdoor experiences, designing and facilitating recreational programs and stewarding our natural environment. The curriculum develops life skills in leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and communication within the context of a Christian worldview. Hands-on learning and field experiences give students practical leadership experience. The program prepares students for careers in state and national park agencies, outdoor education, adventure-based outdoor programming, ecotourism and management of outdoor related businesses. 100 Outdoor Adventure Recreation is a program which intersects with and draws from various disciplines. To maximize these connections and allow students to link their passion for the outdoors to a variety of career paths, courses from psychology, business, kinesiology and biology are included as OAR major electives. The Outdoor Adventure Recreation major is designed to equip students as leaders who are competent in guiding groups in outdoor experiences, designing and facilitating recreational programs and stewarding our natural environment. The curriculum develops life skills in leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and communication within the context of a Christian worldview. Hands-on learning and field experiences give students practical leadership experience. The program prepares students for careers in state and national park agencies, outdoor education, adventure-based outdoor programming, ecotourism and management of outdoor related businesses. 100 Outdoor Adventure Recreation is a program which intersects with and draws from various disciplines. To maximize these connections and allow students to link their passion for the outdoors to a variety of career paths, courses from psychology, business, kinesiology and biology are included as OAR major electives.

The Outdoor Adventure Recreation major is designed to equip students as leaders who are competent in guiding groups in outdoor experiences, designing and facilitating recreational programs and stewarding our natural environment. The curriculum develops life skills in leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and communication within the context of a Christian worldview. Hands-on learning and field experiences give students practical leadership experience. The program prepares students for careers in state and national park agencies, outdoor education, adventure-based outdoor programming, ecotourism and management of outdoor related businesses. 100 Outdoor Adventure Recreation is a program which intersects with and draws from various disciplines. To maximize these connections and allow students to link their passion for the outdoors to a variety of career paths, courses from psychology, business, kinesiology and biology are included as OAR major electives.
